# catalyst_webhook_cron (Resource)

Manage a pre-defined Webhook Job Scheduling cron using a five-field expression, daily/monthly/yearly calendar, one-time timestamp or relative periodic interval. Exactly one schedule mode is required; timezone defaults to UTC. Recurring schedules require end_time; one-time schedules omit it. Requires an existing Webhook job pool and the `ZohoCatalyst.cron.CREATE`, `.READ`, `.UPDATE`, and `.DELETE` scopes, plus `ZOHOCATALYST.projects.Read` to distinguish an absent cron from lost project access. Crons default to disabled. Enabling a cron schedules real HTTP requests and may incur Catalyst usage charges. Updates and deletion verify target ownership. Deletion waits up to two minutes for confirmed absence and respects cancellation; failures preserve state. Import using `project_id/cron_id`. Secret values are marked sensitive but remain in Terraform state; secure your state storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalyst_webhook_cron" "example" {
  project_id  = var.project_id
  job_pool_id = var.job_pool_id
  name        = "terraform_example"
  job_name    = "terraform_example"
  description = "Disabled webhook schedule managed by Terraform"

  expression = "0 9 * * 1-5"
  timezone   = "Asia/Kolkata"
  end_time   = var.end_time
  enabled    = false

  url    = "https://example.com/your-webhook"
  method = "get"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_name` (String) Name used for jobs submitted by this cron (1–20 characters).
- `job_pool_id` (String) ID of an existing Webhook job pool in the project.
- `name` (String) Unique cron name in the project.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project ID. Changing it replaces the cron.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Absolute HTTP or HTTPS webhook URL, without embedded user credentials or a fragment. Marked sensitive because query parameters may contain secrets.

### Optional

- `body` (String, Sensitive) Webhook request body. Defaults to an empty string.
- `calendar_schedule` (Attributes) Daily, monthly or yearly calendar schedule, using the resource timezone. Choose dates or weeks/weekdays for monthly/yearly schedules. Mutually exclusive with expression, one_time_at and interval_seconds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--calendar_schedule))
- `description` (String) Cron description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cron submits jobs. Defaults to false; set true deliberately to activate the schedule.
- `end_time` (Number) Required positive end timestamp in Unix seconds for recurring schedules. Omit for one-time schedules; the API end sentinel is computed.
- `expression` (String) Five-field cron expression. Set exactly one of expression, calendar_schedule, one_time_at or interval_seconds.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Webhook headers as string values. Defaults to an empty map.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Positive relative repetition interval in seconds. Recurring end_time is required. Relative intervals use the default UTC and omit the wall-clock timezone from API requests. Select exactly one schedule mode.
- `method` (String) Lowercase HTTP method: get, post, put, delete, head, or patch. Defaults to get.
- `one_time_at` (Number) One-time execution Unix timestamp in seconds. Omit end_time for this mode; use a future timestamp when enabling. Select exactly one schedule mode.
- `params` (Map of String, Sensitive) Webhook parameters as string values. Defaults to an empty map.
- `retry_count` (Number) Number of retries for failed jobs. Defaults to zero; Catalyst validates its service limits.
- `retry_interval` (Number) Retry interval in seconds. Use 60 to 86400 seconds with retry_count greater than zero; otherwise leave zero.
- `timezone` (String) IANA wall-clock timezone for expression/calendar/one-time schedules; defaults to UTC. Periodic intervals use UTC because they measure elapsed time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cron ID as an exact numeric string.

<a id="nestedatt--calendar_schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `calendar_schedule`

Required:

- `hour` (Number) Hour of day, 0–23 in timezone.
- `minute` (Number) Minute, 0–59.
- `repetition` (String) daily, monthly or yearly.
- `second` (Number) Second, 0–59.

Optional:

- `days` (Set of Number) Dates in the month, 1–31. Use dates or the weeks/weekdays pair. Defaults to an empty set.
- `months` (Set of Number) Months: 1 is January and 12 is December. Required for yearly schedules; omit for daily/monthly. Defaults to an empty set.
- `week_days` (Set of Number) Exactly one weekday: 1 Sunday, 2 Monday, 3 Tuesday, 4 Wednesday, 5 Thursday, 6 Friday, 7 Saturday. Multiple weekdays are rejected by the service. Supply with weeks_of_month, instead of days. Defaults to an empty set.
- `weeks_of_month` (Set of Number) Weeks, 1–5. Supply with week_days, instead of days. Defaults to an empty set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Use the matching provider data center, organization and environment.
terraform import catalyst_webhook_cron.example '12345678901234567/12345678901234568'
```
